capabilities: Replace selected text with redaction characters
Choose a preset or custom redaction character
Preserve word lengths or use a fixed redaction length
Limit or exclude redaction by folder
Redact several selections in a single undo step
disambiguation: Not a text-hiding or spoiler tool; it rewrites the selected text in the note rather than covering it.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later and must be installed manually until it is in the community directory. The README warns that undo history, File Recovery snapshots, sync services and backups can still hold the original text, and that redaction length and line count remain visible.
problem: Notes that are shared or published can contain text that should be visibly struck out in the note itself rather than merely hidden from view.
summary: Command that replaces selected text with block or custom characters, using per-character, space-preserving or fixed-length redaction styles.
